description: The ceiling fan in the computer lab sparks and stops spinning while the desktop computers stay online.
The wall outlet that powers the projector is loose and the plug falls out.
The power strip behind the server rack is hot to the touch and smells burnt.
The distribution board that controls the library lights is buzzing loudly.
The breaker for the computer lab shuts off whenever the laser printer starts.
The battery backup for the network room light is not charging.
The ceiling fan in the examination hall slows down and makes a grinding noise.
The wall socket beside the office printer sparks when a plug is inserted.
The battery backup in the server room beeps continuously and does not hold a charge.
The extension cord supplying the classroom projector overheats and the casing is melting.
The lights in the computer lab flicker whenever the air conditioner starts.
The backup generator for the server room fails to start during an outage.
The electrical panel near the IT office is warm and buzzing.
The wall switch in the library is broken and the reading room lights stay off.
The power outlet behind the water cooler is cracked and loose.
The ceiling light above the office printer flickers and then goes out.
The projector in the classroom has power but cannot connect to the campus network.
The library printer appears online but every print job fails with a network timeout.
The biometric attendance device at the hostel entrance is powered but cannot sync records.
Students can reach the campus Wi-Fi but the authentication page times out.
The Wi-Fi access point in the library is powered but clients cannot connect.
The network switch in the computer lab is powered but all connected desktops have lost connectivity.
The internet is down in the hostel but the lights and sockets are working normally.
The office desktop is powered on but has no network connection.
The network cable in the classroom is damaged and the projector cannot reach the internet.
The printer is plugged into a working socket but cannot connect to the print server.
The campus email service rejects every login with a server error.
The firewall is blocking access to the campus email service.
The attendance scanner has power but cannot upload records to the server.
The smart classroom display turns on but cannot load the network lesson portal.
The LAN port in the library is active but the network login fails.
The conference room camera is powered but the video call cannot connect to the meeting server.
